Subject: BrightArc evaluation operations play & kickoff schedule

Thanks again for a productive call today — wanted to capture the recap and proposed schedule so we can lock calendars.

High-level plan (proposed)
- Duration: 6 weeks (validation + readout)
- Kickoff: Tues, May 26 — 30 minute sync to confirm access/roles
- Weekly check-ins: Tuesdays 10:00 AM PT (30 mins) — Marissa to run product/validation cadence
- Final readout: Week 6 Friday — presentation + acceptance checklist

Success criteria (what BrightArc will use to accept)
- Latency: 95th percentile <= 300ms for 1k token prompts in our staging workload
- Quality: embedding similarity uplift >= 0.12 vs current baseline (A/B eval set)
- Stability: <1% inference errors under 10 concurrent sessions
- Ops: reproducible runbook + automated token-cost estimate for 1M tokens

Owners
- Sales lead / commercial: Dylan Brooks
- Solutions & validation cadence: Marissa Cole
- Implementation / infra liaison: Neha Kapoor
- BrightArc eng: Kai Huang
- Procurement: Angela Park

Immediate next steps (ask)
1) Kai — confirm kickoff date (May 26) and share SSO / IP allowlist window
2) Angela — procurement timeline for NDA/SOW redlines (I attached a draft)
3) Marissa/Neha — I'll schedule the weekly recurring and drop the drive folder + template scripts

Attachments: trial_scope_v1.pdf; mutual_action_plan.xlsx

Thanks,

Dylan Brooks

Dylan — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming we’re aligned on the plan with two small asks:

1) Kickoff: May 26 works better for our eng team if it’s later in the day (we can do 1:00 PM PT). Can you do 1pm? If not, 10am is OK.
2) Data access: we’ll need a short-term S3 read-only role + IP allowlist for your staging cluster. I can share the contact for our infra if you need specifics.

We reviewed the success criteria internally — our PM team added a usability metric (search recall on top-10 results >= 0.78) that they'd like included in the acceptance checklist. Happy to bake that into the mutual_action_plan.

Forwarding Dylan’s note inline below for visibility.
